title: Working well
text: Working well. Working well. Good air flow and love the remote. Loved this fan so much the 1st I bought it in 2017 that I came back and bought another one in 2018 for another room.

product_metadata.title: Holmes 12-Inch Fan | Blizzard Rotating Fan with Remote Control, Black
features: Convenient remote controls fan from anywhere in the room
Three speed settings to select optimal comfort
Rotating grill for wide area coverage
Automatic shutoff timer powers down the fan
Ideal for large rooms up to 500 sq. ft.
description: Create a blizzard of coolness with specially designed motor and blade combination to propel powerful airflow and generate cooling comfort in large rooms. With three speed settings, two breeze settings, and adjustable-tilt head for directing airflow more precisely, providing maximum effectiveness. The rotating grill increases airflow by 40% and covers a wider area. Program your fan to run up to 8 hours and then shut off automatically. Because it operates in a quiet mode, it's ideal in living rooms, bedrooms, and home offices. 3-year limited warranty.
